liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Playing In The Band** (3 reviews): Playin' is judged one of the best ever versions; Reviewer ranks this Playin' in their top ten of 100+ versions: supple, gentle, jazzy, a bit freaky [6][14][16]
- **Dark Star** (3 reviews): Dark Star into Eyes Of The World is singled out as a standout, with fiery Eyes; Reviewer had a set-two soundboard tape years ago; the Dark Star alone won them over [5][8][14]
- **They Love Each Other** (1 review): A jaunty They Love Each Other gets listeners dancing right away [8]
- **Bird Song** (1 review): Bird Song is singled out as outstanding [9]
- **China Doll** (1 review): China Doll is described as gorgeous and beautiful [5]
- **Casey Jones** (1 review): The Casey Jones is called unbelievable [6]

## The recordings

- **gd1973-02-22.sbd.miller.111169.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 153 min; rated 3.22/5 by 18 [1]
- **gd73-02-22.pset2-sbd.carman.12215.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 136 min; rated 4.45/5 by 20 [2]
- **gd1973-02-22.sbd.elliot.10963.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 136 min; rated 4.4/5 by 5 [3]. Said about its sound: Sound is tremendous, with every instrument clear [16]
- **gd1973-02-22.sbd.hamilton.166.shnf**: soundboard; 10 songs; 88 min [4]. Said about its sound: There is some tape waver during Box Of Rain; Channels switch back and forth at the start of Dark Star, with a brief dropout at 4:53; A reel splice occurs at 1:32 in Goin' Down The Road Feeling Bad [4]

## Around the show

- New Riders of the Purple Sage opened and got the crowd on its feet earlier than usual [11]
- Attendee recalls crowd energy and a tight band in great humor [11]
- The band plays 18 songs for the Champaign-Urbana audience, not counting Beer Barrel Polka [15]
- Donna mostly stays in the background, and her audible contributions are fairly good [16]
- Dane County gets the tour's fanfare, but this show stands alone and is no weak imitation of it [6]
- Reviewer says this spring tour was a highlight of the year; 2/15, 2/19 and 3/24 also have great jams [8]
- Attendee also saw the Fox Theatre in St. Louis a week earlier and thought that show slightly better [11]
- Like 2/15, this show has good transitions around Dark Star into Eyes Of The World [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1973-02-22.sbd.miller.111169.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat [1]
- **gd73-02-22.pset2-sbd.carman.12215.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]. Also: This is a reworking of an earlier shn set, done by Randy Carman [2]
- **gd1973-02-22.sbd.elliot.10963.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD:MR>Cas>DAT>CD [3]. Also: Deadlists reportedly says the whole show except Around And Around exists on soundboard; four set-one songs are absent from this copy; Shntool shows tracks cut on sectors, but they carry non-canonical headers and extra baggage [3]
- **gd1973-02-22.sbd.hamilton.166.shnf**: transferred by Greg Hamilton; source: MR > DAT > 1 cassette gen. > DAT > CDR 3x [4]
